text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's been hurting since last night.
I took some medicine, but...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
This is troublesome. I have a mountain of rival
data analysis to get through after this.
I hope this kicks in quickly.
choice_data_list: You really shouldn't push yourself too hard...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I know. ...But I feel so restless.
The road to being the strongest is only half-traveled; I have no time to be held back by a headache—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ow...! Ah, geez!
What a huge pain!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps it's the toll of using her eyes so much,
but Royce and Royce found herself plagued
by headaches."
